title: Bug: `test_posttest.py::test_recover_rsyslog_rate_limit` fails with `Error response from daemon: No such container: frr_bmp`
author: arista-nwolfe
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

`test_posttest.py::test_recover_rsyslog_rate_limit` fails trying to run commands in `frr_bmp` docker container but that docker container doesn't exist.

`frr_bmp` shows up in the output of `show feature status`
```
show feature status
Feature         State            AutoRestart     SetOwner
--------------  ---------------  --------------  ----------
bgp             enabled          disabled
bmp             enabled          disabled        local
database        always_enabled   always_enabled
dhcp_relay      disabled         disabled        local
eventd          enabled          disabled
frr_bmp         enabled          disabled        local
<snip>
```

Which `test_recover_rsyslog_rate_limit` iterates over and runs
`docker exec -i frr_bmp supervisorctl restart rsyslogd`

But there is no `frr_bmp` docker container.

Other PRs have been skipping this feature: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22588

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `test_posttest.py::test_recover_rsyslog_rate_limit`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

`test_posttest.py::test_recover_rsyslog_rate_limit` shouldn't try to run docker commands on `frr_bmp`

linkedPullRequests.title: Skip `frr_bmp` in `test_posttest.py::test_recover_rsyslog_rate_limit`
linkedPullRequests.author: arista-nwolfe
linkedPullRequests.body:
`test_posttest.py::test_recover_rsyslog_rate_limit` iterates over the results of `show feature status` and executes the following commands:
```
docker exec -i frr_bmp sed -i 's/^#\\$SystemLogRateLimit/\\$SystemLogRateLimit/g' /etc/rsyslog.conf
docker exec -i frr_bmp supervisorctl restart rsyslogd
```

`frr_bmp` shows up in `show feature status` but it isn't a real docker container so we should skip it.
Similar PR: https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22588
